name: knowledge-gardener
description: Acceptance criteria for the knowledge gardener plan in PLAN.md. Do not edit this file while implementing: verify.mjs prints its hash and the goal checks that hash. A criterion that is wrong is a question for the maintainer, recorded in PROGRESS.md, not an edit.

howCriteriaPass.test: At least one unit test whose name contains the tag [KG-x.y] passes in the suites verify.mjs runs, and no test with that tag fails. A test must exercise the behaviour the criterion names; a test that asserts nothing about it is a failed review, not a pass.
howCriteriaPass.file: The file exists and matches the regular expression.

phases.title: Connect knowledge to the product graph

criteria.title: An agent cannot promote or verify an entry through a single update
criteria.detail: POST /v1/page_entries/:id from a User with type Agent that sets status STANDING or DISPUTED, or sets verified, is refused with 403 and changes nothing. The same request from a human member succeeds.

criteria.title: An agent cannot promote or verify entries through bulk triage
criteria.detail: POST /v1/page_entries/bulk from an agent is refused for any triage decision; a human's bulk request still applies. The service receives the writer's identity, not only the workspace id.

criteria.title: Duplicate detection runs on the server for every write path
criteria.detail: Creating an entry whose normalised content matches an existing PROPOSED or STANDING entry on the same page returns a needs-decision response and writes nothing, unless the request supersedes an entry or declares it distinct. This holds for a raw REST call, not only for the agent-core remember path.

criteria.title: A read-only agent token can load context
criteria.detail: POST /v1/knowledge/context and any other read-through-POST knowledge route carry @RequiresScope('read'), so a token with only the read scope can call load_context over MCP.

criteria.title: Interactive search records demand once per settled query
criteria.detail: The webapp search dialog sends one knowledge search after the user pauses typing (500 ms, matching issue search), not one per keystroke. The debounce logic is extracted where a Vitest test can drive it with fake timers.

criteria.title: Decay reads lastServedAt
criteria.detail: The decay job keeps a STANDING entry that was served within the configured window, even if retrievalCount was once non-zero long ago, and archives an unverified STANDING entry that has not been served within the window.

criteria.title: Phase 0 passed an independent review
criteria.detail: A fresh reviewer (subagent or /code-review) read the phase diff against PLAN.md and these criteria; every finding is fixed or answered in PROGRESS.md.

criteria.title: Pages link to products, modules and capabilities
criteria.detail: PageLinkType gains PRODUCT, MODULE and CAPABILITY (schema, migration, @vantikhq/types). Creating, listing and reverse-looking-up links works for each, and a link whose target was deleted is dropped on read like the existing kinds.

criteria.title: An entry's scope resolves to module ids
criteria.detail: PageEntry stores moduleIds resolved from its scope against ModuleRepo.pathPrefixes. It uses modules/module-routing.ts. The server recalculates these IDs after a scope change or a change to module repositories or prefixes. SQL reads these IDs from the source table for filters and rank scores.

criteria.title: Scope matches by path prefix
criteria.detail: A query scoped to apps/server/prisma returns an entry scoped to apps/server; a query scoped to apps/webapp does not return an entry scoped to apps/server/prisma. Page bodies and unscoped entries stay eligible for a scoped query, ranked below scoped matches.

criteria.title: Entries have a kind
criteria.detail: PageEntry.kind is one of FACT, DECISION, CONVENTION, GOTCHA (default FACT). remember, the REST API, agent-core and the CLI accept it; search can filter by it; the working-vantik-knowledge skill explains when to use each.

criteria.title: Retrieval can be seeded from modules or an issue
criteria.detail: load_context and recall accept moduleIds or an issueId. The seed expands one hop over the curated graph (the module's owning product, capabilities that list the module, modules linked to that product) and those modules boost ranking. No LLM is involved.

criteria.title: Agents and the webapp can use the new links
criteria.detail: The MCP tools pages_for and link_page accept PRODUCT, MODULE and CAPABILITY. The product, module and capability screens show the linked pages and the standing entries resolved to that module or product.

criteria.title: Phase 1 passed an independent review
criteria.detail: As KG-0.R, for phase 1.

criteria.title: Entries carry citations
criteria.detail: A PageEntryCitation model (kind CODE, ISSUE, PULL_REQUEST, COMMENT or RUN; for CODE the repository, path, commit SHA, line range, snippet text and snippet hash; last check time, SHA and result) with a migration. remember, the REST API, agent-core and the CLI accept citations, and the skill tells agents that a claim about code must cite it and a decision must cite where it was decided.

criteria.title: A code citation is checked when it is written
criteria.detail: On create, each CODE citation is read at its cited SHA. If the snippet is at the cited lines the citation is recorded as HOLDS. If it is not, the write is refused with a message naming the failing citation so the agent can correct it.

criteria.title: Repository files are read through one interface
criteria.detail: A file source reads a path at a ref for a module repository: the GitHub integration through the contents API with the installation token it already holds, the local-repo integration through git. A source that cannot be reached yields UNKNOWN, which is retried later and never counts as a failed citation.

criteria.title: Re-checking against current code needs no LLM to tell moved from changed
criteria.detail: Checking a CODE citation against the default branch head returns HOLDS (snippet at the same lines), MOVED (snippet found elsewhere; line range updated), CHANGED (snippet not found) or MISSING (file gone), decided by comparing content.

criteria.title: A changed citation is judged by a different model from the writer
criteria.detail: Only CHANGED goes to an LLM, asked whether the current code still supports the claim; it answers holds, contradicted or unclear and names the lines it relied on. The judge uses a model role other than the one recorded for the writer where one is known, and the model used is stored. With no LLM configured the result is unclear.

criteria.title: Non-code citations are checked
criteria.detail: ISSUE, PULL_REQUEST, COMMENT and RUN citations are checked for existence in the workspace; a deleted or foreign target fails the citation.

criteria.title: Entries have a trust tier and ranking uses it
criteria.detail: Each entry exposes trust HUMAN_VERIFIED, GROUNDED (all citations hold and the server accepted it without a human), or UNGROUNDED. SQL ranks human-verified entries above grounded entries and grounded entries above ungrounded entries for otherwise equal matches.

criteria.title: Served knowledge shows its proof and age
criteria.detail: Every item returned by recall, load_context, the MCP tools and the run context pack includes its trust tier, its citations, and when and at which SHA it was last checked.

criteria.title: Phase 2 passed an independent review
criteria.detail: As KG-0.R, for phase 2.

criteria.title: Each served entry is recorded as a use
criteria.detail: A PageEntryUse row (entry, agent run when known, session, token, via CONTEXT_PACK | RECALL | LOAD_CONTEXT, time) is written for every entry served. retrievalCount and lastServedAt keep updating.

criteria.title: Hosted runs receive knowledge
criteria.detail: The context pack no longer hard-codes knowledge: []. It carries the CONVENTION entries resolved to the issue's modules plus the top KNOWLEDGE_CONTEXT_TOP_K (default 5) relevant grounded or human-verified entries, within a token budget, and the prompt renders each with its citation and age.

criteria.title: A holdout measures whether knowledge helps
criteria.detail: A configurable share of hosted runs (KNOWLEDGE_HOLDOUT_RATE, default 0.1) receive no knowledge. The arm is chosen deterministically per run and stored on the run.

criteria.title: Run outcomes become helpful and harmful signals
criteria.detail: When a run ends, each entry it was served gets a helpful signal if verification passed and the review accepted with no finding in the entry's scope, and a harmful signal for a finding or failing command whose evidence path falls under the entry's citations or scope. Counts are stored per entry. A harmful signal queues a re-check and never archives or deletes on its own.

criteria.title: Pull request results feed the same signals
criteria.detail: A merged pull request for a run's issue adds a helpful signal to the entries that run was served; one closed without merging adds a weak harmful signal.

criteria.title: The treatment and holdout arms are compared
criteria.detail: An endpoint and a Settings -> Agents panel show, per arm: number of runs, verification pass rate, mean review passes, mean cost and merge rate.

criteria.title: Phase 3 passed an independent review
criteria.detail: As KG-0.R, for phase 3.

criteria.title: An exact duplicate corroborates instead of adding a row
criteria.detail: A new entry whose normalised content hash matches an existing entry in the same module neighbourhood increments that entry's corroboration count and records the source; no second row is served.

criteria.title: Near neighbours are related by links, not edits
criteria.detail: Candidates are PROPOSED and STANDING entries sharing a module (or the page, when unscoped). Only above a configurable similarity threshold does an LLM classify the pair as DUPLICATE, REFINES, SUPERSEDES, CONTRADICTS or DISTINCT. The result is stored as a relation; no existing entry's text is changed. A difference in a number, date, negation or condition, or invalid LLM output, yields DISTINCT.

criteria.title: Triage runs as a job and records every decision
criteria.detail: Creating an entry enqueues a triage job on the pages queue. It records a decision (AUTO_ACCEPT, CORROBORATE, ESCALATE with reasons, REJECT with the policy broken) together with its inputs, the models used and their outputs.

criteria.title: Auto-accept needs every condition
criteria.detail: An entry is auto-accepted only if the policy checks pass, it is grounded (every citation holds; an entry without citations is not grounded), nothing it CONTRADICTS is human-verified or on a LOCKED page, it is not a CONVENTION asking to be pinned, and two independent judgments agree. Anything else escalates with the reason.

criteria.title: Triage starts in shadow mode
criteria.detail: KNOWLEDGE_AUTO_TRIAGE is off | shadow | on, default shadow, with a per-workspace override in Workspace.preferences read the way agent-run-settings.ts reads agent defaults. In shadow mode decisions are recorded and entry status is not changed.

criteria.title: Contradictions resolve by fixed precedence
criteria.detail: Human-verified beats grounded beats ungrounded; within a tier the newer entry wins. Code applies this order; the LLM only reports that a contradiction exists.

criteria.title: Triage works without an LLM
criteria.detail: With no LLM configured, the deterministic stages still run, and any decision that needs an LLM escalates. Nothing is auto-accepted on a check that did not run.

criteria.title: Secrets are rejected and external input escalates
criteria.detail: Content matching the secret patterns is rejected. An entry written by a run whose issue came from an external integration (GitHub issue sync, email, Discord, support) is never auto-accepted; it escalates with reason EXTERNAL_INPUT.

criteria.title: Phase 4 passed an independent review
criteria.detail: As KG-0.R, for phase 4.

criteria.title: The review queue holds escalations and audits
criteria.detail: The queue API and /pages/review list escalated entries with their reason labels and audit items, filterable by reason. When triage is off, the queue behaves as it did before this plan.

criteria.title: A sample of auto-accepted decisions is audited
criteria.detail: KNOWLEDGE_AUDIT_RATE (default 0.1) of auto-accepted decisions, chosen by a seeded draw, are queued as audits. A human's agree or disagree verdict is recorded against the decision.

criteria.title: Agreement is measured with Cohen's kappa per decision type
criteria.detail: For each decision type, agreement between triage and human verdicts over a rolling window is computed as Cohen's kappa with counts, and exposed through an endpoint and the settings page. The kappa function is tested against known values.

criteria.title: Automation backs off when agreement drops
criteria.detail: A decision type whose kappa falls below KNOWLEDGE_KAPPA_FLOOR (default 0.6) with at least KNOWLEDGE_KAPPA_MIN_SAMPLES (default 20) verdicts escalates instead of acting until it recovers. Each change is logged.

criteria.title: Human actions resolve escalations and feed the metrics
criteria.detail: Accepting, rejecting or editing an escalated or audited entry resolves it and records the verdict used in KG-5.3.

criteria.title: Phase 5 passed an independent review
criteria.detail: As KG-0.R, for phase 5.

criteria.title: Every merged change reaches the server with its SHA
criteria.detail: Merged pull requests (and pushes to the default branch where the integration sees them) produce a code-change event carrying the merge SHA and changed paths even when no issue key is named. Routing modules to issues for keyed pull requests is unchanged.

criteria.title: A code change re-checks the citations it touches
criteria.detail: Entries with CODE citations in the changed paths are re-checked: HOLDS refreshes the check time, MOVED updates the lines, a contradicted claim moves the entry to DISPUTED and opens a correction issue labelled knowledge, and MISSING escalates an archive proposal.

criteria.title: Recurring reviewer findings become conventions
criteria.detail: Reviewer findings are grouped per module across runs. After KNOWLEDGE_CONVENTION_MIN_RUNS (default 3) distinct runs, a candidate CONVENTION entry is written with RUN citations and the code citations from the findings' evidence, and goes through triage. It is served by retrieval when relevant. Pinning it to every run in the module escalates to a human, and it is disabled automatically when its harmful signals pass a threshold.

criteria.title: Knowledge gaps become issues
criteria.detail: A scheduled job (KNOWLEDGE_GAP_ISSUES_CRON, default weekly, off disables, registered like PAGE_DECAY_CRON) opens one issue per gap above a count threshold, grouped by module when the query resolves to one. It never opens a second issue for the same gap, and the gap is marked answered when an entry citing that issue is accepted.

criteria.title: Decay accounts for checks and outcomes
criteria.detail: An entry is archived only when it has been neither served nor re-checked as HOLDS within the window. A harmful signal triggers a re-check, not archiving. A human-verified entry is never archived automatically; it escalates instead.

criteria.title: Phase 6 passed an independent review
criteria.detail: As KG-0.R, for phase 6.

criteria.title: Pages are authored or generated
criteria.detail: Page.kind is AUTHORED (default) or GENERATED. A generated page states the question it answers, and every section cites the entries it was written from.

criteria.title: Generated pages refresh only when their evidence changed
criteria.detail: A refresh runs only when an entry in the page's scope changed since the last build (a stored watermark) and a minimum interval has passed; otherwise nothing is called or written.

criteria.title: Refreshes are edits, and a failed retrieval writes nothing
criteria.detail: The LLM returns operations against section ids. Sections no operation touches stay byte-identical, operations naming unknown ids are dropped, and an empty or failed retrieval aborts the refresh without writing.

criteria.title: Consolidation keeps the evidence
criteria.detail: Entries a page cites stay retrievable as evidence rather than being retired. For an authored page, consolidation produces a proposal that a human accepts, recorded in PageHistory.

criteria.title: Every refresh can be seen and undone
criteria.detail: Each generated-page refresh writes PageHistory with the previous body, and the existing revert restores it.

criteria.title: The knowledge bank has user documentation
criteria.detail: apps/docs has a page describing the knowledge bank: entries, citations and trust tiers, triage and escalation, audits and agreement, the holdout, and every setting this plan adds with its default.

criteria.title: Phase 7 passed an independent review
criteria.detail: As KG-0.R, for phase 7.
